parole.significato: jackdaw (birds of genus Coloeus, particularly Coloeus monedula)
parole.testo: Of Turkic origin, ultimately imitative from the call га-га (ga-ga, “kak-kak”). Compare Turkish karga (“crow”).

Unclear. Cognate with Serbo-Croatian та̀љиге pl, Slovene tolíga, Czech taliha within Slavic and Hungarian taliga, Turkish talika in other languages. * Native derivation presumes origin from obsolete Proto-Slavic *tel- / *tol- / *tal- (“to bear, to undergo”) + -ига (-iga), from the same root as Bulga
Of Turkic origin, cognate with Chuvash тӑрна (tărna), Turkish turna, Tajik турна (turna).
Of Turkic origin, akin to Turkish tunç.

parole.significato: khan (ruler over various Turkic and Mongol peoples in the Middle Ages)
parole.testo: Derived from a Turkic language. Doublet of кан (kan).
